entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6086"/><div sID="gen9299" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6086"/><hi type="bold">7. mine eye ... desire--</hi>(compare <reference osisRef="Ps.59.10">Psa 59:10</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.112.8">112:8</reference>), expresses satisfaction in beholding the overthrow of his enemies as those of God, without implying any selfish or unholy feeling (compare <reference osisRef="Ps.52.6">Psa 52:6</reference>, <reference osisRef="Ps.52.7">7</reference>). <chapter eID="Ps.54"/>
